compute_summary: MDLM-OWT 130M, institutional HPC 2x H100 NVL, 6 lanes per GPU, ~5 min wall per lambda for 27 cells. Theory-motivated by Pre-Equilibrium Saturation Theorem Corollary 2; intervention attempt 11 of disclosed-negative.
grid: r in {4,16,64} x rho in {0.05,0.40,0.90} x n=3 seeds = 27 cells per lambda
mechanism_implication: Entropy bonus -lambda * H(p_theta) does NOT push top-1 mass below baseline at tested lambda. Possible explanations: (a) entropy is computed over full vocabulary so model can be both confident at top-1 AND have high entropy by spreading remaining mass uniformly, (b) the optimizer balances CE+entropy by finding LoRA updates that increase confidence (lower CE) more than they decrease confidence (entropy bonus), (c) at 200-step horizon, the model has not reached asymptote so Corollary 2's lambda > lambda* prediction is in untested regime. Either way, K15t at empirically tested lambda is not a working intervention. Gradient noise scales sharply with lambda (max-grad ratio 0.86 -> 5.97), suggesting training instability not stability.
preregistered_threshold: WORKS: fire-rate <27/27 AND top-1 mass at step 199 substantially lower than baseline. PARTIAL: top-1 mass meaningfully reduced but fire-rate unchanged. DOESN'T: fire-rate unchanged AND top-1 mass unchanged or increased.
schema: K15t anti-concentration entropy regularizer: add -lambda * mean_entropy(p_theta(.|x_masked)) to loss. Direct theory-motivated penalty against top-1 concentration. MDLM-OWT 130M. Round 11 lambda-sweep over {0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0} added 2026-05-21 with paired baseline mean_top1_traj evidence.
theorem_corollary_2_status: REFUTED at tested lambda. Theorem (S_t monotone -> 1 under masked-CE convergence) remains supported by D2 derivation + LLaDA 671-cell empirical fire-step universality. Corollary 2 (entropy regularization lowers asymptote in lambda) is NOT supported empirically on MDLM at the 200-step horizon for lambda <= 10. A possible critical lambda* > 10 may exist but at 200-step the regularizer dominates loss (final loss -100 at lambda=10) without crossing top-1 below 0.5.
verdict: NEGATIVE across lambda in {0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0} on MDLM at 200-step horizon (was misclassified as PARTIAL in Round 10 due to false baseline value).
